packageRules.description: Non-major Action bumps: one PR each, merged by .github/workflows/automerge.yml via the automerge label (PAT path keeps the lovable->dev MERGE / others SQUASH policy). The 7-day wait mirrors scripts/check-dep-release-age.mjs, whose lockfile diff cannot see workflow pins - this is the only place that policy can bind for actions.
Major Action bumps need a human decision.

Dev Container image and features: mcr.microsoft.com and ghcr.io publish no tag push time (Docker datasource timestamps are Docker-Hub only), so no age gate here - it would hold these updates pending forever. Bumps are human-reviewed because the typescript-node tag must stay aligned with the node-version used by CI workflows.
